items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sex and the Single Girl was another movie we did with Jerry Lewis

ctx.x: There’s what you get from being a bandsman. There’s what you get from arranging for the band. There’s royalties from recordings. There’s rates on top of rates, because you’re on tour, because you’re doing television.
Right. There were also a few movies. Cinderfella, Jerry Lewis. Sex and the Single Girl was another movie we did with Jerry Lewis, and a couple of other ones.
Did he like jazz, Jerry Lewis?
